verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST API, CLI and MCP channels with per-resource read endpoints such as contacts, but no export feature for all data in open formats. Per-endpoint API access is only a developer building block from which an export could be constructed. It is not the export-and-leave capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
